steps.npc: What can I interest you in? Need any pipes? I make very sturdy pipes.

steps.player: No, not really... what kind of shop is this anyway?

steps.npc: Why, it's Wemund's Wrench Warehouse. Wemund, that's me.
I don't really sell just wrenches, you know, I sell anything related to the maintenance of dwarven steam machines.
Sometimes I do repair work as well. Or I send my assistant.
Oh, he's right over there... used to work in the mines to the south, poor lad. Made a bit of a mess of things I believe.
So what'll it be then? Got any ship engines to repair?

steps.player: Thanks, but I don't think your services are required.
